parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

parameters.name: DeployRegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region in which the service instance is deployed.

parameters.name: EnablePrivateVpcConnection
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the private connection feature. Valid values:

*   true
*   false

parameters.name: ServiceInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the service instance.
